guide.dynamic_cooking.title: Cooking Guide
guide.dynamic_cooking.pot.title: 1. Set up the pot
guide.dynamic_cooking.pot.text: Place the Cooking Pot on top of heat: a lit campfire, furnace, smoker or blast furnace, fire, a magma block or lava.
guide.dynamic_cooking.add.title: 2. Add ingredients
guide.dynamic_cooking.add.text: Right-click the pot with an ingredient to add it, up to %s. The pot tells you what it will make. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take the last one back.
guide.dynamic_cooking.water.title: 3. Add water
guide.dynamic_cooking.water.text: Stews (meat or fish) and soups (vegetables or mushrooms) need a Water Bucket. You get the empty bucket back.
guide.dynamic_cooking.cook.title: 4. Cook
guide.dynamic_cooking.cook.text: Right-click the pot with an empty hand to start cooking. A bell rings when the dish is ready.
guide.dynamic_cooking.serve.title: 5. Serve
guide.dynamic_cooking.serve.text: Scoop a stew, soup or Dubious Mush out with a Bowl. Take any other dish out with an empty hand. The pot takes new ingredients once it is empty.
guide.dynamic_cooking.craft.title: Crafted dishes
guide.dynamic_cooking.craft.text: These are made on a crafting table instead: %s. Put the ingredients anywhere in the grid.
guide.dynamic_cooking.raw.title: Raw dishes
guide.dynamic_cooking.raw.text: The pot cooks raw ingredients. Crafted dishes keep them raw: less filling, and some can make you sick. Cook a raw dish in a furnace, smoker or campfire, or alone in the pot. Raw fish is fine in a kelp roll.
guide.dynamic_cooking.mix.title: Mixing
guide.dynamic_cooking.mix.text: Extra ingredients must suit the dish. Seasonings, seeds and milk suit anything. In the pot, a mix that fits no dish becomes Dubious Mush. Foods with effects, like golden apples, pass all their effects on. Two of the same buff add up; two different buffs cancel out.
guide.dynamic_cooking.dishes: The next pages show every dish. Hover over a picture to see its name.
